eden.description: A circle: sequence and continuity, like life itself. Eden seats six in a round shell, so everyone faces everyone. Enjoy it endlessly, with the people closest to you.

fusion.description: A fusion of everything you need: space, function, beauty and just enough. Fusion is another word for balance.

zen.description: Room to choose and room to want. Sink in, listen to what you need and let the water do the rest. Change seats until you find the perfect one. Be ZEN.

spa-control.d: Electronics are the brain of every hot tub. We use components from the Canadian maker Gecko: simple to use, reliable and long-lasting. Control panels range from in.k200 to in.k1000, depending on the package.

online.d: Control your tub when you are away. Switch it on from your phone, set the temperature, pumps and lights, and the water is ready when you arrive.

hydro-pump.d: If the electronics are the brain, the pumps are the heart. 2 or 3 hp, low power use and quiet running.

aero-pump.d: A powerful pump with a built-in heater sends warm air to every air jet. The massage feels better and the water cools less. It runs quietly too.

jets.d: Jets and controls are what you actually touch, so they have to be well made and good-looking. We use Gecko’s combo series, built for every kind of weather. With them, the pumps show their full power while running almost silently.

circulation.d: Runs continuously, moving all the water through the filter and heater, so the tub is always ready to use.

inclear.d: Gecko’s in.clear releases bromine into the water to remove bacteria, algae and organic matter, for pleasant, relaxing water every time.

ozone.d: Turns oxygen from the air into ozone, which reaches every part of the system and keeps the water crystal clear.

filter.d: An activated-carbon filter with very fine perforations stops leaves, grass and small debris that land on the water.

uv.d: UV light removes a wide range of bacteria that could otherwise settle in the water.

water.d: Cleanwater Blue keeps the water clear and chemically balanced, with no chemical smell and gentle on the skin.

heater.d: A 3 kW heater built into the control unit, adjustable in 0.5 °C steps.

insulation.d: 10 mm PU insulation with an aluminium foil layer keeps the heat in, saves energy and protects the components. For colder climates there is a 30 mm option.

cover.d: Made to measure from high-density PU foam, with a thermal film and a synthetic leather cover that resists moisture and UV. The edges slope gently so water runs off.

tarp.d: A waterproof, made-to-measure cover that protects the tub through winter, together with the thermal cover.

frame.d: A rigid frame that does not twist even when the tub is moved, and does not carry the sound of pumps and electronics. An HDS high-density styrene frame is also available.

cladding.d: Sinter Wood cladding looks like timber but needs no maintenance: it stands up to weather and knocks and dampens sound. In Grey Wood and Rose Wood.

stairs.d: Non-slip steps for easy, safe access, in several colours.

led.d: A rich spectrum of colours turns the bubbles into a play of light. The High Light version has a chrome ring.

aroma.d: Choose a favourite scent for deeper relaxation: cedar, citrus, eucalyptus, peach and more.

sound.d: Quick Bluetooth pairing, good sound and simple to use.

service.d: Faults never come with a warning. With this service package our technician comes within 72 hours of your call, with spare parts if needed.

about.title: About Favorit SPA
about.metaTitle: About Favorit SPA – hot tub manufacturer from Šabac, Serbia
about.metaDesc: Favorit SPA is a small European hot tub manufacturer from Šabac, Serbia. 30 years of making, selling and servicing seven models for 2 to 6 people, with Gecko components and spare parts in stock.
about.lead: A small European hot tub manufacturer from Šabac, Serbia. For thirty years we have designed, built, sold and serviced our own tubs, from the first sketch to the last spare part.
facts: address: production and showroom in Šabac

p: We are Favorit, a team of engineers, designers and makers who have been producing hot tubs in Šabac for three decades. Everything happens under one roof: design, production, sales and service.
Call it a hot tub, a spa, a jacuzzi or a massage pool. For us it is always the same thing: a tub that is well made, comfortable to sit in, pleasant to touch and powerful when the jets come on.

Robotised machines form and finish the acrylic shells with the same precision every time. Our team then reinforces, insulates, wires and assembles each tub by hand and checks it down to the last detail before it leaves the workshop.
We stay small on purpose. It lets us know every tub we build and change a detail the day we learn something new.

The controls, pumps and jets come from the most respected names in the spa industry, including Gecko from Canada and Waterway. We choose parts that are simple to use, quiet and built to last, so the tub runs on its own and you only enjoy it.
Every spare part you might need is already on our shelves. Order by noon on a working day and it is at your address the next day.
Our engineers answer by phone and over video call, so most questions are solved in minutes. Your Favorit SPA should always be ready for the next evening.

Energy-efficient pumps (class A+) and heaters (class C), good insulation and a fitted cover keep the bills small. On average across our range, energy and filters come to about 20 EUR a month, roughly the price of an espresso a day.

sections.h: Where you will find our tubs
p: Favorit tubs warm terraces on the Adriatic coast, chalets in mountain ski resorts and gardens across Europe, from Sweden to Greece. With the right package they run all year, in summer heat and in snow.

visit.p: See the tubs in person, sit in them and talk to the people who make them. Our showroom and production in Šabac are open Monday to Saturday.

faq: Where are Favorit hot tubs made?
In our own production in Šabac, Serbia, where we also have a showroom. Favorit DOO has been making hot tubs for 30 years.
How long does a Favorit hot tub last?
With regular care, 15 to 20 years. Clean the filter regularly, replace it once a year and prepare the tub properly if it stands unused in winter.
Do I need plumbing to install one?
No. You need a level concrete base and a power cable. The tub is filled with a garden hose and drained through the built-in valve.
What does it cost to run?
On average about 20 EUR a month for energy and filters, depending on the model, the package and how often you use it.
24 months for private use and 12 months for commercial use, covering all built-in components. Service and spare parts stay available after the warranty ends.

guide.title: User guide
guide.metaDesc: How to install, fill, start, use, clean and winterise a Favorit SPA hot tub. Step by step, with water care and troubleshooting.
guide.lead: Everything you need from delivery to the first evening in the water, and the routine that keeps the tub clean for years. Keep the printed manual and warranty card that came with your tub; this page follows the same order.
safety: Electrical connection only by a licensed electrician, with a residual current device (RCD).
Children in or near the tub only under supervision. Keep the cover closed and locked when the tub is not in use.
Water temperature up to 40 °C. Shorter sessions at higher temperatures; pregnant women and people with heart conditions should ask their doctor first.
No alcohol or medication that causes drowsiness before using the tub.
Always switch off the power before opening the technical compartment or draining the tub.

steps: Prepare a level, load-bearing concrete base about 40% larger than the tub, so you can walk around it for cleaning and service.
Bring a power cable (3×2.5 mm² or 5×2.5 mm², depending on the model and package) to the base, about 4 m long, ending inside the tub's footprint.
Fit a residual current device (RCD) and fuses as specified for your model. The connection is made by a licensed electrician.
Leave every side of the tub accessible. No water supply or drain is needed.
chapters.tip: Decking or larch boards around the tub make getting in and out easier and keep the water cleaner.

steps: Check that the drain valve on the lower side of the tub is closed.
Put the garden hose into the filter compartment and fill the tub with clean tap water.
Fill up to the marked level, a few centimetres above the highest jets. Never switch the tub on while it is empty or half full.
For the first filling, add a shock treatment (for example ALGA-SOKK P) as described on the product label.
chapters.tip: Filling through the filter compartment pushes air out of the pipes and helps the pumps start smoothly.

steps: Switch on the power. The Gecko control panel lights up and the tub runs a short start-up check.
The circulation pump starts and the system removes air from the lines. If a pump sounds noisy, switch it on and off a few times from the panel.
Set the temperature on the panel. The heater warms the water gradually; the first heating takes several hours, depending on the model, the water temperature and the weather.
Keep the thermal cover closed while heating. It saves energy and shortens the wait.
chapters.tip: Most owners keep the water at 36–38 °C and turn it up a degree or two just before using the tub.

steps: Use the panel buttons to switch the jet pumps, air pump and lights on and off. Each press cycles through the available speeds.
Turn the jet nozzles to adjust direction and strength; the diverter valves move power between seats.
Pumps switch off automatically after a set time, so a forgotten tub does not run for hours.
After use, close the cover. Ozone, circulation and filtering continue on their own.
chapters.tip: With the smartphone platform you can switch the tub on and set the temperature before you get home.

steps: Check the water once a week with test strips. Keep pH between 7.2 and 7.6 and the sanitiser at the level shown on the product you use.
Add chlorine-free sanitiser (for example DEWAN-20 P) and an algae preventer (ALGI-CID) as the labels describe. The built-in ozone and, if fitted, UV lamp and in.clear do most of the work.
Against foam and grease lines use an enzyme cleaner (BIOPOOL G).
Change the water when it needs it, usually every few weeks. Owners report anything from 5 to 25 days, depending on use and care.
chapters.tip: Water treated only with ozone, without added chemicals, can go straight onto your lawn when you drain it.

steps: Rinse the filter with a garden hose every week.
Once a month, soak it overnight in filter cleaner (for example DINAX FILTER FIZZY P) and rinse well.
Replace the filter at least once a year. Filters are consumables and are not covered by the warranty.
Always switch the power off before removing the filter.
chapters.tip: A spare filter lets you swap them over and dry the clean one properly.

steps: Switch off the power.
Attach a hose to the quick drain valve on the lower side of the tub and open it.
Wipe the acrylic with a soft cloth and a mild, non-abrasive cleaner. Never use solvents or scouring powders.
Rinse, close the valve and refill as in chapter 2.
Tubs with the right package (insulation and heating for low temperatures) can stay in use all winter. Keep the water above freezing and the cover closed and fastened.
If the tub will not be used, drain it completely, open all valves, remove the filters and blow remaining water out of the lines.
Dry the shell, put the thermal cover on and protect it with the weather cover.
Never leave a tub with water in it switched off in freezing temperatures. Damage from frozen pipes is not covered by the warranty.
chapters.tip: Not sure if your package is rated for winter? Check the operating temperature range on your model's page or call us.

steps: Water not heating: check the breaker, the water level and the filter. A clogged filter stops the heater for safety.
Weak jets: clean the filter, check the water level and that the jet nozzles are open.
Cloudy or green water: clean the filter, check pH, give a shock treatment and run the pumps.
A message on the display: note it and call us. Most messages are solved in minutes over the phone or a video call.

guide.helpText: Our engineers answer by phone and video call. Spare parts ordered by noon on a working day arrive the next day.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.metaDesc: How to keep the water in a Favorit SPA hot tub clean: a simple weekly and monthly routine, and the water care products we recommend, with dosage.
maintenance.lead: Clean water takes a few minutes a week. The ozone generator, circulation pump and filter do most of the work; you test, top up and rinse. Here is the routine and the products we use and sell ourselves.
schedule: Shower before you get in. Close and fasten the cover when you get out.
Test pH (7.2–7.4) and sanitiser. Add DEWAN-20 P and ALGI-CID. Rinse the filter with a hose.
Shock the water with ALGA-SOKK P. Soak the filter overnight in DINAX FILTER FIZZY P. Add BIOPOOL G if you see foam or grease lines.
Every few weeks, depending on use. Clean the pipes with DINASAN P before draining. Add DINAX METAL MAGIC F when filling with hard or well water.
Fit a new filter, check the cover and prepare the tub for winter, or keep it running with the right package.
maintenance.volumeNote: Doses below are per cubic metre (m³) of water. Favorit tubs hold between about 0.4 and 2.3 m³; the volume of each model is on the Documentation page.
maintenance.productsLead: Professional water care products, tested and certified, available from us with your tub or with your next order.

products.name: ALGA-SOKK® P
products.use: Periodic shock treatment: at first filling, once a month and before you start with DEWAN-20 P. Removes biofilm from pipes and jets.
products.dose: 2–3 spoonfuls into the full tub. Run the pumps for over 10 minutes, a few times. Leave for at least 2 hours. When the jets no longer release biofilm, drain, rinse and refill.

products.name: DEWAN®-20 P
products.use: Everyday disinfection without chlorine. Works 3 hours after dosing and keeps the water clean between shocks.
products.dose: Keep 3–5 mg/l, checked with DEWAN-20 test strips. Add once a week, dissolved in water, together with ALGI-CID. Keep pH between 7.2 and 7.4.

products.name: ALGI-CID
products.use: Stops green and dark algae, cloudy water, bad smell and blocked filters. Works at any pH, biodegradable and does not foam.
products.dose: First dose with a fresh fill, then a small weekly dose together with the sanitiser, as on the label.

products.name: DINAX® MINUS P
products.use: Brings pH back to 7.2–7.4, where sanitisers work best.
products.dose: About 0.1 kg per m³ of water, dissolved. Test again before adding more. Wear gloves and goggles.

products.name: BIOPOOL G
products.use: Breaks down grease, slime and biofilm, reduces foam and helps the filter. Non-toxic and biodegradable; the full effect builds over a month.
products.dose: First use 20 ml per m³, then 10 ml per m³ once a week, into the filter compartment.

products.name: DINASAN P
products.use: Cleans and disinfects the pipes and jets you cannot reach: biofilm, oils, soap and grease that cause foam.
products.dose: Before draining: 250 g per m³ into the filter compartment. Circulate 5 minutes, stop, leave 2 hours, circulate again, drain and rinse.

products.name: DINAX® METAL MAGIC F
products.use: Prevents scale and brown staining from iron, for example when you fill from a well or have hard water.
products.dose: 30–50 ml per m³ while filling; 50 ml per m³ for hardness below 20 °GH. Do not overdose.

products.name: DINAX® FILTER FIZZY P
products.use: Deep-cleans paper filters from mineral deposits.
products.dose: Dissolve one sachet A and one B in 5–10 l of hot water. Soak the filter 1 hour, or up to 24 hours if very dirty. Rinse upright under running water and let it dry.

maintenance.safety: Always read the label before using any chemical, store products dry and cool, and never mix them with each other. Keep them away from children.
maintenance.guideP: Filling, first start, water care, filters, draining and winter are covered in detail in the user guide.
maintenance.askP: Send us a photo of the water or the test strip and we will tell you what to add.

control.title: Gecko control system
control.metaTitle: Gecko control system in Favorit SPA hot tubs – keypads, app and accessories
control.metaDesc: Every Favorit SPA hot tub runs on Gecko electronics from Canada: in.k keypads from in.k200 to the in.k1000 touchscreen, the in.touch 2 app, in.clear water care and in.stream audio.
control.lead: The electronics are the brain of a hot tub. Ours come from Gecko Alliance in Canada, one of the most widely used spa control makers in the world: simple to use, reliable, and serviced everywhere in Europe.
brain: The box under the cabinet that runs the heater, pumps, lights and circulation and protects them against faults.
The panel on the rim. It shows the water temperature and lets you start the jets, lights and programmes.
With the optional in.touch 2 module, the same controls are in an app on your phone, wherever you are.
control.keypadsLead: The keypad depends on the model and the equipment package. All of them keep the temperature, run the filtration cycles automatically and show a message if something needs attention.

in.k200: Four buttons and a bright LED temperature display. Everything you need for a smaller tub, nothing more.
in.k300: A clear LCD display and direct buttons for pumps, light and temperature. Simple and robust.
in.k500: A colour display with animated icons, water care modes, filtration schedules, keypad lock and maintenance reminders. Works with in.touch 2, in.clear and in.stream.
in.k800: A larger colour display and ten buttons for tubs with more equipment: several pumps, lights, audio and water care in one place.
in.k1000: A 4.3-inch colour touchscreen with no buttons at all. Menus as on a phone, and software that can be updated from the keypad.

control.appP: The in.touch 2 module connects the tub to your home internet over a long-range radio link, so it works even at the end of the garden. The in.touch 2 app for iOS and Android does what the keypad does, from anywhere.
app: Water care mode and filtration cycles
control.appNote: Available as the Smartphone platform option on Advance and Privilege packages.
control.modesLead: Choose how the tub heats and it does the rest. The economy setting lowers the temperature when you are not using the tub.
modes: Always economy, for when you travel.
Never economy, the water is always at your temperature.
Economy during peak hours on weekdays, full comfort at weekends.
Economy during peak hours every day.
Economy on weekdays, ready for the weekend.
extras: Automatic water care that turns a bromide salt (BromiCharge) in the water into bromine, so you add far fewer chemicals by hand.
Bluetooth audio built into the tub: speakers in the cabinet, music from your phone.
Underwater and rim lighting in changing colours, switched from the keypad or the app.
control.matrixH: Which keypad comes with which tub
control.matrixLead: Standard keypad per model and package. The in.k1000 touchscreen can be added to Privilege.
control.ctaP: Our engineers know every Gecko component we fit and help by phone or video call.
